title_en: Two speeds: the popularity list saturates early, a personalised model keeps improving (exploratory)
title_zh: 两种速度：热门榜很早就饱和，个性化模型还在继续提升（探索性）
rule: In more than half of the judged datasets, the sample size where the popularity list reaches 95% of its own best is at least two grid steps below that of the best pure personalised model (k = all, panel NDCG@100).
reading_en: From N=100 to the largest tested N, the popularity list's panel score grows by a median factor of 1.22 while the best personalised model's grows by 1.94; the popularity list reached 95% of its best at least two grid steps earlier in 4 of 7 datasets.
reading_zh: 从 N=100 到最大被测 N，热门榜在验证小组上的得分中位数增长 1.22 倍，而最好的纯个性化模型增长 1.94 倍；7 个数据集中，有 4 个里热门榜至少提早两个网格步就达到了自身最好成绩的 95%。
